transport_retries: Preserved in all arms, including no-recovery; no short whole-task timeout.

variants.no-profile: Remove discovered facts; retain applicable instructions
variants.no-context-selection: Keep entire request history; stop at context-window budget rather than send oversized input
variants.no-planning: Remove planning tools and plan step fields
variants.no-recovery: Stop task/protocol failures; preserve transient MODEL_ERROR retries

smoke_gate: Manually inspect native tools, terminal outcomes, verifier and telemetry; preserve invalid/interrupted trials before any replacement.
limitations: One sample per cell; descriptive evidence only. Mechanism activation must be checked in real traces; no benefit is a valid result.
